brief:
Israeli forces and settlers conducted raids across the occupied West Bank, detaining several Palestinians and injuring at least two others, Middle East Eye reported. The operations targeted multiple locations in the territory.

Details of the specific locations, the identities of those detained, and circumstances surrounding the injuries remain unclear. Such raids have been a recurring feature of Israeli military operations in the West Bank.
dek: Several Palestinians detained, two injured during raids by Israeli forces, settlers Several Palestinians were detained and several were injured in raids by Israeli forces and settlers in the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli forces and settlers detain Palestinians, wound two in West Bank raids
